1 """Home attention — the deterministic v0 ranking behind the steward's rail and the
2 "Needs attention" rows on the home page.
3 
4 Design contract: ``_mockups/dashboard-v2`` (prototype r3, 2026-08-27/28) and its
5 SCORECARD — "Ranked. One raise. ... no hidden score" — as read by the 2026-08-29
6 best-in-class addendum ("home is an attention and intervention surface, not a
7 repository browser"; "Anchor should show the exact rule that raised an item").
8 
9 Pure: takes facts, returns rows. No I/O, no model, no clock of its own (the
10 caller passes ``today``/``now``), never raises on odd input. The ranking IS the
11 rule order below; every row names the rule that raised it so the order is
12 explainable, and nothing here is a score a user cannot see.
13 
14 The steward's own raise queue is NOT computed here — it needs the Ecgberht
15 bridge process, which the home render must never spawn. The page adds that row
16 client-side from the badge it already polls (``static/high-seat.js``).
17 """
18 from __future__ import annotations
19 import re

21 from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

23 # Rule order == rank order. (name, severity, plain label)
24 RULES = (
25     ("health", "red", "health check"),
26     ("needs-you", "red", "a session is waiting on you"),
27     ("overdue", "red", "overdue task"),
28     ("due-today", "amber", "due today"),
29     ("due-soon", "amber", "due within five weeks"),
30     ("failed", "amber", "failed session (7 days)"),
31 )
32 _RANK = {name: i for i, (name, _sev, _lab) in enumerate(RULES)}
33 _SEV = {name: sev for name, sev, _lab in RULES}
34 _LABEL = {name: lab for name, _sev, lab in RULES}
35 
36 FAILED_WINDOW = timedelta(days=7)
37 # Lanes whose sessions are project work a person can act on. Swarm seats and
38 # other engine-internal lanes fail and finish on their own; they are not
39 # "waiting on you".
40 ACTIONABLE_LANES = frozenset(
41     {"research", "plan", "planning", "build", "general", "grass", "steward"})

44 def _iso_date(v):
45     """'YYYY-MM-DD' → date, else None. Tolerates datetimes and junk."""
46     if isinstance(v, date):
47         return v
48     s = str(v or "").strip()[:10]
49     try:
50         return date.fromisoformat(s)
51     except Exception:
52         return None
53 
54 
55 def _ts(v):
56     """epoch seconds / ISO string → datetime (naive, local), else None."""
57     if v is None or v == "":
58         return None
59     try:
60         if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
61             return datetime.fromtimestamp(float(v))
62         return datetime.fromisoformat(str(v).replace("Z", "+00:00")).replace(tzinfo=None)
63     except Exception:
64         return None

80 def build_attention(tasks=(), sessions=(), health=None, today=None, now=None,
81                     project_names=None, limit=6, projects=()):
82     """Return the ranked attention rows (at most ``limit``).
83 
84     ``tasks``    — home task dicts (``text`` · ``priority`` · ``due`` · ``done``).
85     ``sessions`` — session-registry records (``status`` · ``lane`` · ``project_id``
86                    · ``label`` · ``updated_at``/``created_at``).
87     ``health``   — ``(report_date, status)`` from the latest health report or None.
88     ``projects`` — ``home_rows.project_facts`` dicts (W1a, High Seat 2026-09-26): a project whose
89                    steward record waits on John raises a needs-you row; its open dated steps raise
90                    overdue / due-today / due-soon rows (soonest first, within five weeks).
91     ``today``    — date; ``now`` — datetime (both default to the wall clock only
92                    when omitted, so tests pass them explicitly).
93     """
94     today = today or date.today()
95     now = now or datetime.now()
96     names = project_names or {}
97     rows = []
98 
99     # 1. health — the daily self-test found issues (the red banner's fact)
100     try:
101         if health:
102             report_date, status = health[0], str(health[1] or "")
103             if any(w in status.upper() for w in ("ISSUE", "FAIL", "ERROR")):
104                 rows.append(_row(
105                     "health", "Health check found issues",
106                     "%s — Doctor can diagnose it" % report_date,
107                     "/doctor?issueId=ZH_HEALTH_CHECK_ISSUES&diagnose=1", "system"))
108     except Exception:
109         pass
110 
111     # 2. needs-you — a managed session parked in needs-attention
112     needs, failed = [], []
113     for rec in sessions or ():
114         try:
115             if not isinstance(rec, dict):
116                 continue
117             pid = str(rec.get("project_id") or "")
118             lane = str(rec.get("lane") or "")
119             if not pid or (lane and lane not in ACTIONABLE_LANES):
120                 continue
121             st = str(rec.get("status") or "")
122             when = _ts(rec.get("updated_at")) or _ts(rec.get("created_at"))
123             if st == "needs-attention":
124                 needs.append((when or datetime.min, rec, pid))
125             elif st == "failed" and when and now - when <= FAILED_WINDOW:
126                 failed.append((when, rec, pid))
127         except Exception:
128             continue
129     needs.sort(key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=True)
130     # one needs-you row per project (W1a): the project's own steward record — the strip's human
131     # wait, else the last status's "waiting on you" — is the fact when it exists, and the row says
132     # so; a managed session parked in needs-attention raises the row otherwise, and says that
133     record_wait = {}
134     for f in projects or ():
135         try:
136             if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("id") and f.get("needs_you"):
137                 why = " ".join(str(f["needs_you"]).split())
138                 why = (why[:88].rstrip() + "…") if len(why) > 90 else why
139                 record_wait[str(f["id"])] = (str(f.get("name") or str(f["id"])[:8]), why)
140         except Exception:
141             continue
142     seen = set()
143     for when, rec, pid in needs:
144         if pid in seen:
145             continue
146         seen.add(pid)
147         if pid in record_wait:
148             nm, why = record_wait[pid]
149             rows.append(_row("needs-you", "%s is waiting on you" % nm, why, "/project/%s" % pid,
150                              "project", pid, label="the steward's record waits on you"))
151         else:
152             nm = names.get(pid) or rec.get("label") or pid[:8]
153             rows.append(_row("needs-you", "%s is waiting on you" % nm,
154                              "%s session needs an answer" % (rec.get("lane") or "a"),
155                              "/project/%s" % pid, "project", pid))
156     for pid, (nm, why) in record_wait.items():
157         if pid in seen:
158             continue
159         seen.add(pid)
160         rows.append(_row("needs-you", "%s is waiting on you" % nm, why, "/project/%s" % pid,
161                          "project", pid, label="the steward's record waits on you"))
162 
163     # 3./4. tasks — overdue (oldest first, P1 first), then due today (P1 first)
164     overdue, due_today = [], []
165     for t in tasks or ():
166         try:
167             if not isinstance(t, dict) or t.get("done"):
168                 continue
169             d = _iso_date(t.get("due"))
170             if d is None:
171                 continue
172             pr = int(t.get("priority") or 3)
173             if d < today:
174                 overdue.append((d, pr, t))
175             elif d == today:
176                 due_today.append((pr, t))
177         except Exception:
178             continue
179     overdue.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1], x[2].get("text", "")))
180     due_today.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1].get("text", "")))
181     for d, pr, t in overdue:
182         days = (today - d).days
183         rows.append(_row("overdue", t.get("text", ""),
184                          "P%d · due %s (%d day%s ago)" % (pr, d.isoformat(), days, "" if days == 1 else "s"),
185                          "#tile-tasks", "task"))
186     for pr, t in due_today:
187         rows.append(_row("due-today", t.get("text", ""), "P%d · due today" % pr,
188                          "#tile-tasks", "task"))
189     # 3b./4b./4c. dated steps — a project's open steps that carry a due (W1a): overdue, due today,
190     #     and due within five weeks (the ruler's reach), soonest first; each links to its plan
191     late, todays, soon = [], [], []
192     horizon = today + timedelta(days=35)
193     for f in projects or ():
194         if not isinstance(f, dict):
195             continue
196         for st in f.get("dated") or ():
197             try:
198                 d = _iso_date(st.get("due"))
199                 if d is None:
200                     continue
201                 if d < today:
202                     late.append((d, st))
203                 elif d == today:
204                     todays.append((d, st))
205                 elif d <= horizon:
206                     soon.append((d, st))
207             except Exception:
208                 continue
209     for bucket in (late, todays, soon):
210         bucket.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1].get("name", "")))
211     for d, st in late:
212         days = (today - d).days
213         rows.append(_row("overdue", st.get("name", ""),
214                          "due %s (%d day%s ago) · %s" % (_short(d), days, "" if days == 1 else "s", st.get("project_name", "")),
215                          "/project/%s" % st.get("project_id", ""), "step", st.get("project_id", "")))
216     for d, st in todays:
217         rows.append(_row("due-today", st.get("name", ""), "due today · %s" % st.get("project_name", ""),
218                          "/project/%s" % st.get("project_id", ""), "step", st.get("project_id", "")))
219     for d, st in soon:
220         rows.append(_row("due-soon", st.get("name", ""), "due %s · %s" % (_short(d), st.get("project_name", "")),
221                          "/project/%s" % st.get("project_id", ""), "step", st.get("project_id", "")))
222 
223     # 5. failed — recent failed sessions, newest first
224     failed.sort(key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=True)
225     for when, rec, pid in failed:
226         nm = names.get(pid) or rec.get("label") or pid[:8]
227         rows.append(_row("failed", "%s: a %s session failed" % (nm, rec.get("lane") or "work"),
228                          when.strftime("%a %d %b %H:%M"), "/project/%s" % pid, "project", pid))
229 
230     rows.sort(key=lambda r: _RANK[r["rule"]])  # stable: keeps each rule's own order
231     return rows[: max(0, int(limit or 0))] if limit else rows

234 def _short(d):
235     """date → 'Oct 8'."""
236     d = _iso_date(d)
237     return ("%s %d" % (d.strftime("%b"), d.day)) if d else ""

240 def brief_bullets(rows, projects=(), today=None, seat_name="High Seat"):
241     """The rail's brief as bullets (W1a, High Seat 2026-09-26): the move, who waits on him, what the
242     week holds (or the nearest date), and the standing line. Facts only; never more than four."""
243     today = today or date.today()
244     bullets = []
245     top = rows[0] if rows else None
246     if top:
247         bullets.append("%s%s." % (top["text"], (" — " + top["why"]) if top.get("why") else ""))
248     else:
249         bullets.append("Nothing is waiting on you.")
250     # who waits: counted from the facts (every project whose record waits), never from the capped rows
251     waiting = [str(f.get("name") or "") for f in projects or () if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("needs_you")]
252     for r in rows or ():
253         if r.get("rule") == "needs-you":
254             nm = r["text"].replace(" is waiting on you", "")
255             if nm not in waiting:
256                 waiting.append(nm)
257     if len(waiting) > 1:
258         bullets.append("%d wait on you: %s." % (len(waiting), ", ".join(waiting[:4]) + (" and more" if len(waiting) > 4 else "")))
259     # the week is the header's: Monday to Sunday; a date already past inside it is named overdue
260     week_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())
261     week_end = week_start + timedelta(days=6)
262     dated = []
263     for f in projects or ():
264         if isinstance(f, dict):
265             for st in f.get("dated") or ():
266                 d = _iso_date(st.get("due"))
267                 if d is not None:
268                     dated.append((d, st))
269     dated.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1].get("name", "")))
270     this_week = [(d, st) for d, st in dated if week_start <= d <= week_end]
271     if this_week:
272         def _say(d, st):
273             tag = "overdue since %s" % _short(d) if d < today else ("today" if d == today else _short(d))
274             return "%s (%s, %s)" % (st.get("name", ""), tag, st.get("project_name", ""))
275         bullets.append("This week: " + "; ".join(_say(d, st) for d, st in this_week[:3]) + ".")
276     else:
277         ahead = next(((d, st) for d, st in dated if d >= today), None)
278         if ahead:
279             bullets.append("Nothing is due this week; the nearest date is %s (%s, %s)." % (
280                 _short(ahead[0]), ahead[1].get("name", ""), ahead[1].get("project_name", "")))
281         else:
282             bullets.append("Nothing carries a date yet.")
283     bullets.append("You can act from here. Opening the %s is optional." % seat_name)
284     return bullets[:4]

302 def _part_open(p):
303     return (isinstance(p, dict) and not p.get("broken") and p.get("status") not in ("done", "parked")
304             and p.get("target_status") not in _PART_CLOSED)

307 def _wait_reason(p):
308     """What a seated initiative waits for: the reason the tile line already reads ("waiting on you: <reason>"); empty
309     when the state is not a wait, when the reason only repeats the part's name, or when it only names him (Grok's
310     read of W2b: the sentence never restates its own head)."""
311     st = str(p.get("state") or "")
312     if not st.lower().startswith("waiting on you"):
313         return ""
314     reason = re.sub(r"^waiting on you[:\s]*", "", st, flags=re.I).strip(" .")
315     name = " ".join(str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "").lower().split())
316     if not reason or " ".join(reason.lower().split()) == name or reason.lower() in ("john", "you", "me"):
317         return ""
318     return reason

321 def head_act(initiatives, facts, today=None):
322     """THE HEAD — one act, never a list (W2 of the steward revision, 2026-09-28; the synthesis R2; his answer Q3).
323     The SEATS read first (2026-09-30, his three levels): an ACTIVE initiative — a cockpit, an effort or a desk item
324     he pulled out of its goal — that needs him leads, in his order; then one ON DECK that needs him; the sentence
325     says the date when there is one. Then his tiers: the first Tier-1 part that needs him, in his
326     order (a Tier-1 part that needs him AND is due comes first among them); the one exception, his word (narrowed on
327     Grok's W2 read): a Tier-2/3 part that NEEDS him and is due today or overdue — marked as the exception, with its
328     date — earliest date first, then his tier and order; it yields to a Tier-1 part that needs him and is due, and to
329     anything inside the set (an outside deadline while he is deep in the set is W3's nudge, not the head). Else the
330     oldest wait across the projects, with its age from the record. ``None`` when nothing needs him and nothing is
331     due."""
332     today = today or date.today()
333     inits = sorted([i for i in initiatives or () if isinstance(i, dict)],
334                    key=lambda i: (i.get("tier") or 9, int(i.get("order") or 0), str(i.get("name") or "")))
335 
336     def _act(i, p, kind, **more):
337         parts = [x for x in i.get("parts") or () if isinstance(x, dict)]
338         after = next((x for x in parts[parts.index(p) + 1:] if _part_open(x)), None) if p in parts else None
339         a = {"kind": kind, "tier": i.get("tier"), "initiative": str(i.get("name") or ""), "text": str(p.get("text") or ""),
340              "target": str(p.get("target") or ""), "pid": str(p.get("pid") or ""), "href": str(p.get("href") or ""),
341              "date": str(p.get("date") or ""), "then": str(after.get("text") or "") if after else "", "age_days": None,
342              "effort": "", "dir": None,
343              # the seated act (2026-09-30): the initiative's own name and what it waits for, said as the sentence says them
344              "part": str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or ""),
345              "what": _wait_reason(p)}
346         a.update(more)
347         return a
348 
349     def _due(p):
350         d = _iso_date(p.get("date")) if p.get("date") else None
351         return d if (d is not None and d <= today) else None
352 
353     def _needs(p):
354         return _part_open(p) and bool(p.get("needs_you"))
355 
356     # the seats read FIRST (2026-09-30): an active initiative that needs him, in his order; then one on deck
357     from high_seat_page import seated
358     for kind in ("active", "deck"):
359         for g, p in seated(inits, kind):
360             if _needs(p):
361                 d = _due(p)
362                 return _act(g, p, kind, due=d.isoformat() if d else "", overdue=bool(d and d < today))
363     # a Tier-1 part that needs him and is due leads everything
364     t1_due = sorted(((_due(p), int(i.get("order") or 0), n, i, p) for i in inits if i.get("tier") == 1
365                      for n, p in enumerate(i.get("parts") or ()) if _needs(p) and _due(p)), key=lambda t: t[:3])
366     if t1_due:
367         _d, _o, _n, i, p = t1_due[0]
368         return _act(i, p, "tier1")
369     # the exception: a lower-tier part that needs him, due today or overdue — earliest date, then tier and order
370     low = sorted(((_due(p), int(i.get("tier")), int(i.get("order") or 0), n, i, p)
371                   for i in inits if i.get("tier") in (2, 3)
372                   for n, p in enumerate(i.get("parts") or ()) if _needs(p) and _due(p)), key=lambda t: t[:4])
373     if low:
374         d, _t, _o, _n, i, p = low[0]
375         return _act(i, p, "exception", due=d.isoformat(), overdue=d < today)
376     for i in inits:
377         if i.get("tier") == 1:
378             for p in i.get("parts") or ():
379                 if _needs(p):
380                     return _act(i, p, "tier1")
381     waits = [f for f in facts or () if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("needs_you")]
382     if waits:
383         f = max(waits, key=lambda f: (f.get("wait_age_days") if isinstance(f.get("wait_age_days"), (int, float)) else -1))
384         return {"kind": "oldest-wait", "tier": None, "initiative": "", "text": str(f.get("needs_you") or ""),
385                 "target": str(f.get("name") or ""), "pid": str(f.get("id") or ""), "href": str(f.get("href") or ""),
386                 "date": "", "then": str(f.get("next") or ""), "age_days": f.get("wait_age_days"),
387                 "effort": str(f.get("needs_you_effort") or f.get("effort") or ""),
388                 "dir": str(f.get("needs_you_effort") or f.get("effort") or "")}
389     return None

392 def pick_up(initiatives, facts=None, working=None, today=None):
393     """What to take up while Active runs (2026-09-30, his three levels): when Active is not empty, nothing in it needs
394     him and every active initiative is RUNNING (a live session on its project) or WAITING on someone else, the top
395     of ON DECK — his own pick-up list, in his order. None otherwise: an active initiative with a free hand is his
396     next act, not a pick-up; an empty Active has nothing to be "while" of; an empty deck offers nothing. The answer
397     says which active initiatives run and which wait, so the sentence can too."""
398     from high_seat_page import seated, part_name
399     working = working or set()
400     inits = [i for i in initiatives or () if isinstance(i, dict)]
401     active = seated(inits, "active")
402     if not active:
403         return None
404     running, waiting = [], []
405     for g, p in active:
406         if _part_open(p) and p.get("needs_you"):
407             return None
408         if p.get("pid") and p["pid"] in working:
409             running.append(part_name(p))
410         elif str(p.get("state") or "").lower().startswith("waiting") or p.get("status") == "waiting":
411             waiting.append(part_name(p))
412         else:
413             return None      # a free hand: that is his next act, not a pick-up
414     deck = seated(inits, "deck")
415     if not deck:
416         return None
417     g, p = deck[0]
418     st = str(p.get("state") or "")
419     what = re.sub(r"^waiting on you:\s*", "", st, flags=re.I).strip() if st.lower().startswith("waiting on you") else ""
420     return {"initiative": part_name(p), "goal": str(g.get("name") or ""), "id": str(p.get("id") or ""), "why": "on deck", "text": what,
421             "pid": str(p.get("pid") or ""), "active": [part_name(x) for _g, x in active], "running": running, "waiting": waiting}

424 def head_sentence(act, overnight=(), pickup=None):
425     """The head as one sentence he can act on: the pick, why now, the exact record (its effort when named), what
426     follows — and, only when a step closed since he last opened the page, what finished (gated on the real
427     instant of his last open: a quiet day and a second open repeat nothing)."""
428     s = _head_core(act)
429     if act is None and isinstance(pickup, dict) and pickup.get("initiative"):
430         run = list(pickup.get("running") or ()) if ("running" in pickup or "waiting" in pickup) else list(pickup.get("active") or ())
431         wait = list(pickup.get("waiting") or ())
432 
433         def _who(names):
434             return (" and ".join(names) if len(names) <= 2 else ", ".join(names[:-1]) + " and " + names[-1]), ("is" if len(names) == 1 else "are")
435         state = []
436         if run:
437             state.append("%s %s running" % _who(run))
438         if wait:
439             state.append("%s %s waiting on someone else" % _who(wait))      # said as the light says it (Grok W1): never "running" for a wait
440         clause = ("While %s run%s" % (("it", "s") if len(run) == 1 else ("they", ""))) if run and not wait else (
441             ("While %s wait%s" % (("it", "s") if len(wait) == 1 else ("they", ""))) if wait and not run else "Meanwhile")
442         s = "Active: %s. %s: pick up %s%s%s (%s)." % (
443             "; ".join(state) or "the set", clause, pickup["initiative"], (" (%s)" % pickup["goal"]) if pickup.get("goal") else "",
444             (" — " + pickup["text"][:80]) if pickup.get("text") else "", pickup.get("why") or "")
445     closed = [x for x in overnight or () if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("name")]
446     if closed:
447         names = ", ".join(str(x["name"]) for x in closed[:3]) + (" and %d more" % (len(closed) - 3) if len(closed) > 3 else "")
448         s += " Since you last opened: %d step%s closed — %s." % (len(closed), "" if len(closed) == 1 else "s", names)
449     return s
450 
451 
452 def _head_core(act):
453     if not act:
454         return "Nothing is waiting on you."
455     age = act.get("age_days")
456     age_s = (" · waiting %d day%s" % (int(age), "" if int(age) == 1 else "s")) if isinstance(age, (int, float)) and age >= 1 else ""
457     then = (" Then: %s." % act["then"][:100]) if act.get("then") else ""
458     if act["kind"] == "exception":
459         when = ("overdue since %s" % _short(act.get("due"))) if act.get("overdue") else "due today"
460         return "Exception, %s: %s (%s, tier %s).%s" % (when, act["text"], act["initiative"], act.get("tier") or "?", then)
461     if act["kind"] == "tier1":
462         where = (" (%s%s)" % (act["target"], (" · " + act["effort"]) if act.get("effort") else "")) if act.get("target") else ""
463         return "Tier 1 · %s: %s%s — waiting on you%s.%s" % (act["initiative"], act["text"], where, age_s, then)
464     if act["kind"] in ("active", "deck"):
465         # a seated initiative (2026-09-30): "Active · Family Trusts (The trusts): <what it waits for> — waiting on you."
466         when = (", overdue since %s" % _short(act.get("due"))) if act.get("overdue") else (", due today" if act.get("due") else "")
467         head = "Active" if act["kind"] == "active" else "On deck"
468         what = str(act.get("what") or "")
469         return "%s · %s (%s)%s — waiting on you%s%s.%s" % (head, act.get("part") or act["text"], act["initiative"], (": " + what) if what else "", when, age_s, then)
470     where = "%s%s" % (act.get("target") or "A project", (" · " + act["effort"]) if act.get("effort") else "")
471     return "%s: %s%s.%s" % (where, act["text"], age_s, then)

474 def rail_counts(sessions=(), rows=(), folders=0, open_projects=0):
475     """The rail's 2×2: open · running · need you · folders."""
476     running = 0
477     for rec in sessions or ():
478         try:
479             if isinstance(rec, dict) and rec.get("status") == "running":
480                 running += 1
481         except Exception:
482             continue
483     need_you = sum(1 for r in rows or () if r.get("kind") == "project")
484     return {"open": int(open_projects or 0), "running": running,
485             "need_you": need_you, "folders": int(folders or 0)}
486 
487 
488 def due_rows(tasks=(), today=None, limit=5, projects=()):
489     """The rail's 'Due today' list — overdue and today, P1 first, as (text, priority, overdue?);
490     a project's overdue or due-today roadmap steps sit beside the tasks (W1a), so the card never
491     says nothing is due while a step is."""
492     today = today or date.today()
493     out = []
494     for f in projects or ():
495         if not isinstance(f, dict):
496             continue
497         for st in f.get("dated") or ():
498             try:
499                 d = _iso_date(st.get("due"))
500                 if d is None or d > today:
501                     continue
502                 out.append((d, 1, "%s · %s" % (st.get("name", ""), st.get("project_name", "")), d < today))
503             except Exception:
504                 continue
505     for t in tasks or ():
506         try:
507             if not isinstance(t, dict) or t.get("done"):
508                 continue
509             d = _iso_date(t.get("due"))
510             if d is None or d > today:
511                 continue
512             out.append((d, int(t.get("priority") or 3), t.get("text", ""), d < today))
513         except Exception:
514             continue
515     out.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[0], x[2]))
516     rows = [{"text": x[2], "priority": x[1], "overdue": x[3]} for x in out]
517     return rows[:limit], max(0, len(rows) - limit)
518 
519 
520 def live_rows(sessions=(), project_names=None, limit=3):
521     """The rail's 'Workbench' list — running sessions, newest first."""
522     names = project_names or {}
523     live = []
524     for rec in sessions or ():
525         try:
526             if not isinstance(rec, dict) or rec.get("status") != "running":
527                 continue
528             pid = str(rec.get("project_id") or "")
529             when = _ts(rec.get("updated_at")) or _ts(rec.get("created_at")) or datetime.min
530             label = rec.get("label") or names.get(pid) or (rec.get("lane") or "session")
531             live.append((when, {"text": str(label), "project_id": pid,
532                                 "lane": str(rec.get("lane") or "")}))
533         except Exception:
534             continue
535     live.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
536     rows = [x[1] for x in live]
537     return rows[:limit], max(0, len(rows) - limit)
